questions.question: Pipe A can empty a filled tank in 28 hours while Pipe B can fill the same tank, when empty, in 35 hours. If alternately Pipes A and B are turned on for an hour each time, starting when the tank is full, how long will it take to empty the tank?
questions.solution:
Pipe A can empty a filled tank in 28 hours,

while Pipe B can fill the same tank, when empty, in 35 hours,

Let total work = LCM of (28, 35) = 140 units

Efficiency of Pipe A = 140/28 = - 5 units

Efficiency of Pipe B = 140/35 = 4 units

⇒ Pipe (A + B) 2 hour’s work = - 5 + 4 = - 1 unit

In 2 hours, both pipes can empty the 1 unit of tank.

Then in 270 hrs, they can empty = - 1 × 135 = -135 units

Remaining tank = 140 - 135 = 5 units

Then, pipe A will empty the tank in 1hr.

**∴ Total hours = 271 hours**

questions.question: The difference between Peter and Preeti’s ages is 5 years. When they married each other 35 years ago, 4 times Peter’s age was the same as 5 times the age of Preeti’s. What is the current sum of their ages?
questions.solution:
Let Peter and Preeti's age be A and B respectively.

The difference between Peter and Preeti’s ages is 5 years,

⇒ A – B = 5

35 years ago, 4 times Peter’s age was the same as 5 times the age of Preeti’s,

⇒ 4(A – 35) = 5(B – 35)

⇒ 4A – 140 = 5B – 175

⇒ 5B – 4A = 35

Solving,

⇒ 5B – 4(5 + B) = 35

⇒ 5B – 20 – 4B = 35

⇒ B = 55

⇒ A = 60

∴ Sum of their present ages = 60 + 55 = 115 years

questions.question: The length of one side of a rhombus is 41 cm and its area is 720 cm². What is the sum of the lengths of its diagonals?
questions.solution:
Area of Rhombus = 1/2 × product of diagonals

⇒ 720 = 1/2 × product of diagonals

⇒ Product of diagonals = 1440

(Side of rhombus)² = (half of one diagonal)² + (half of the other diagonal)²

⇒ (One diagonal)² + (Other diagonal)² = 41 × 41 × 4

(Sum of two diagonal)² = (One diagonal)² + (other diagonal)² + 2 × product of diagonals

⇒ (Sum of two diagonal)² = 6724 + 2880 = 9604

∴ Sum of two diagonal = 98cm

**∴ The square root of 5329 will be 73.**

questions.question:
Consider the given argument and decide which of the given assumption/s is/are implicit.

**Argument:**

Due to IT recession, many software engineers lost their job.

**Assumptions:**

1. IT sector jobs are not secure.

2. IT sector companies lay off software engineers quite often.
questions.solution:
Many software engineers lost their job, but that happened because of the IT recession. Assumption 1 states that “IT sector jobs are not secure” which cannot be followed from the given argument. We can’t be sure that IT sector jobs are not secure. So, Assumption 1 is not implicit.

⇒ R – 13 = 2S – 26

⇒ 2S – R = 13

Three years from now, Sunny’s age will be 3/5 of Ram’s age,

⇒ (S + 3) = 3/5(R + 3)

⇒ 5S + 15 = 3R + 9

⇒ 3R – 5S = 6

Solving,

⇒ 3R – 5(13 + R) /2 = 6

⇒ 6R – 65 – 5R = 12

⇒ R = 77

∴ Ram present age is 77 years.

questions.question: X walks 3 km towards west, and then turns and travels 4 km towards north. The shortest distance between the start and the end point of X’s journey is ______.

Using Pythagoras theorem to find the shortest distance between starting and ending point we get,

**A² ⁺ B² ⁼ C²**

Where C is the longest side of the triangle and A and B are two other sides.

4² + 3² = C²

Thus C = 5

So the shortest distance between starting and ending point is 5m.

questions.question: A train crosses a 375 m long platform in 27 seconds. How long was the train if it was travelling at the speed of 70 km/h?

A train crosses a 375 m long platform in 27 seconds,

⇒ 375 + A = 175 × 3

⇒ A = 150

∴ The length of the train = 150 m

questions.question: A and B together can complete a task in 12 days. However, if A works alone, completes half the job and leaves and then B works alone and completes the rest of the work, it takes 25 days in all to complete the work. If B is more efficient than A, how many days would it have taken B to do the work by herself?
questions.solution:
Given,

(A + B)’s 1 day’s work = 1/12

⇒ 1/A + 1/B = 1/12

Given,

⇒ (A/2) + (B/2) = 25

⇒ A + B = 50

Solving,

⇒ 1/ (50 – B) + 1/B = 1/12

⇒ B² – 50B + 600 = 0

⇒ B² – 30B – 20B + 600 = 0

⇒ B(B – 30) – 20(B – 30) = 0

⇒ B = 30 or B = 20

If B = 30 Then A = 20

If B = 20 Then A = 30

But B is more efficient than A,

∴ B takes 20 days to complete the work.

questions.question: The length of one side of a rhombus is 13 cm and one of the diagonals is 10 cm. What is the length of the other diagonal?
questions.solution:
We know that,

(Side of rhombus)² = (half of one diagonal)² + (half of the other diagonal)²

⇒ 13² = (10/2)2 + (half of other diagonal)²

⇒ 169 – 25 = (half of other diagonal)²

⇒ Half of other diagonal = 12

∴ Length of the other diagonal = 12 × 2 = 24cm

questions.question: In a test, the mean score of 10 boys in a class was 15 while the overall mean score of 25 students in the class was 16.2. What was the mean score of the girls?
questions.solution:
Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

Total score of 10 boys = 10 × 15 = 150

Total score of class = 25 × 16.2 = 405

⇒ Total score of girls = 405 – 150 = 255

∴ Mean score of girls = 255/15 = 17

questions.question: A curved mirror where the reflecting surface is curved inwards is called a ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __concave__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If a hollow sphere is cut into parts and the outer surface of the cut part is painted, then it becomes a mirror with its inner surface as the reflecting surface. This kind of mirror is known as a concave mirror.
 
• Uses of the concave mirror :
 
 
• ​They are often used as shaving mirrors to see a larger image of the face.
 
• Concave mirrors are commonly used in torches, search lights, and vehicle headlights to get powerful parallel beams of light.
 
• The dentists use concave mirrors to see large images of the teeth of patients.
 
• Large concave mirrors are used to concentrate sunlight to produce heat in solar furnaces.
 
 
 
• 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/081a0abb5ecacee18c46148d9ce7b7507df4621152babf712a9e870dffc51d1f.png] 

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
 
• A convex mirror is a spherical reflecting surface (or any reflecting surface fashioned into a portion of a sphere) in which its bulging side faces the source of light.
 
• Convex mirrors are commonly used as rear-view (wing) mirrors in vehicles.
 
• A plane mirror is a mirror with a flat reflective surface. For light rays striking a plane mirror, the angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence.

questions.question:
**Argument:**

Warning: Consumption of alcohol is injurious to health.

**Assumptions:**

1. This warning is not required.

2. Non-alcoholic people are healthy.
questions.solution:
The warning is a type of alert message that is given before starting or using a product or service. So, to alert people about the effects of the product or service, the word ‘warning’ is used.

Alcohol has ill effects on health, so to make people aware about it, warning should be given. So, assumption 1 is not implicit.

It’s not stated anywhere that people who don’t consume alcohol are healthy. So, assumption 2 is not implicit.

Thus, neither assumption 1 nor 2 is implicit.
